answer: Each agent key locks 200 tokens. The ledger slashes every key caught by fraud proofs by 2% per key caught in the same 6-hour window, and the count is public, with no ownership proof needed. A lone cheat on reef survey labeling loses 4 tokens, while fifty caught together lose all. Hollow keys profit only by cheating at once, which packs them into one window, and their stakes stay locked. Losses total 4n², so the n-th fake adds about 8n tokens. Honest meadow-mapping agents rarely notice.
